crossRefs.note: For as the body is one, and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is…
If they were all one member, where would the body be?
Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.
God has set some in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers, then gifts of…
Therefore putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor. For we are members of one another.

parallels.note: If your right eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you…
If your right hand causes you to stumble, cut it off, and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you…
For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members don’t have the same function,
so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually members of one another,
because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.
